decisions.reason: Keeping the hearty bread loaf costs little because it uses established production and its prospects remain uncertain rather than clearly unfavorable, so the option stays open.
The sweet pastry is close to existing confectionery, inexpensive to keep, and has shown no result that makes its value unlikely, so the option remains open.
The farmhouse bread is close to core bakery operations and without adverse results the option is still open at low cost.
With a gold award and status as flagship, the poppy seed stollen has positive value signals and manageable seasonal keeping costs, so keep.
The premium stollen's award and fit with seasonal specialties keep its option valuable and low-cost to retain, so keep.
